name: Tool Argument Project Detection
description: Planning brain must detect project from tool arguments by scanning file paths

evidence.detectionMethod: detectProjectFromArgs scans args JSON for path-like strings, walks up directory tree looking for .sharkconfig
evidence.cacheBehavior: Caches project root by file path to avoid re-scanning on every tool call

criteria.passCondition: Planning brain detects project-a from /tmp/project-a paths, uses session default for /tmp/project-b paths
criteria.failCondition: Planning brain uses cwd or session default for all tool calls regardless of path
